Skills on skills.sh are ranked by anonymous telemetry from running 'npx skills add <owner/repo>'. Vercel's own skills rank highly partly because they launched npx skills alongside their react-best-practices skill.
Seems fishy that you can only tell the leaderboard is from Vercel by clicking the top-left corner, and the top two skills come from Vercel despite more widely-used skills existing in the ecosystem.
The leaderboard is ranked by weekly download count via their 'npx skills' command, which is Vercel's new 'standard' skills installer, so it's obvious their own skills rank at the top.
An explanation of the ranking system would have been nice up front, and without it the leaderboard presentation is misleading.

This is a really good implementation, but I don't lean too heavily into skills, especially other people's — if I'm doing design, who's to say I want instructions like 'pick an extreme' baked in from a featured skill.
Please make a REST API! (request directed at skills.sh)
Why do none of these 'npm for Skills' tools like skills.sh document any way to do basic package management things like updates, version-pinning, or even uninstalls?
